fields.title: Inception
fields.description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology.

fields.title: The Dark Knight
fields.description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who wants to plunge Gotham into anarchy.

fields.title: Interstellar
fields.description: A team of explorers travel through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival.

fields.title: The Matrix
fields.description: A computer hacker learns from mysterious rebels about the true nature of his reality.

fields.title: Pulp Fiction
fields.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, and a gangster's wife intertwine in stories of violence and redemption.

fields.title: The Shawshank Redemption
fields.description: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

fields.title: Parasite
fields.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

fields.title: The Godfather
fields.description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

fields.title: Spirited Away
fields.description: During her family's move to the suburbs, a sullen 10-year-old girl wanders into a world ruled by gods, witches, and spirits.

fields.title: Gladiator
fields.description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

fields.title: Blade Runner 2049
fields.description: A young Blade Runner's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard.

fields.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
fields.description: A writer encounters the owner of a high-class hotel, who tells him of his early years as a lobby boy.

fields.title: Whiplash
fields.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing.

fields.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
fields.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners.

fields.title: Arrival
fields.description: A linguist works with the military to communicate with alien lifeforms after twelve mysterious spacecraft appear around the world.

fields.title: John Wick
fields.description: An ex-hitman comes out of retirement to track down the gangsters that killed his dog and took everything from him.

fields.title: The Silence of the Lambs
fields.description: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer.

fields.title: Coco
fields.description: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather.

fields.title: The Prestige
fields.description: After a tragic accident, two stage magicians in 1890s London engage in a battle to create the ultimate illusion.

fields.title: Alien
fields.description: The crew of a commercial spacecraft encounter a deadly lifeform after investigating an unknown transmission.

fields.title: The Departed
fields.description: An undercover cop and a mole in the police attempt to identify each other while infiltrating an Irish gang in South Boston.

fields.title: Django Unchained
fields.description: With the help of a German bounty-hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal plantation owner in Mississippi.

fields.title: The Shining
fields.description: A family heads to an isolated hotel for the winter where a sinister presence influences the father into violence.

fields.title: Memento
fields.description: A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

fields.title: Wall-E
fields.description: In the distant future, a small waste-collecting robot inadvertently embarks on a space journey that will ultimately decide the fate of mankind.

fields.title: Joker
fields.description: In Gotham City, mentally troubled comedian Arthur Fleck is disregarded and mistreated by society.

fields.title: No Country for Old Men
fields.description: Violence and mayhem ensue after a hunter stumbles upon a drug deal gone wrong and more than two million dollars in cash.

fields.title: The Truman Show
fields.description: An insurance salesman discovers his whole life is actually a reality TV show.

fields.title: Schindler's List
fields.description: In German-occupied Poland during World War II, industrialist Oskar Schindler gradually becomes concerned for his Jewish workforce.

fields.title: Léon: The Professional
fields.description: 12-year-old Mathilda is reluctantly taken in by Léon, a professional assassin, after her family is murdered.

fields.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
fields.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime and corruption.

fields.title: Goodfellas
fields.description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob, covering his relationship with his wife Karen Hill and his mob partners.

fields.title: Seven
fields.description: Two detectives, a rookie and a veteran, hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives.

fields.title: Arrival at Midnight
fields.description: A fictional noir mystery where a train arrives at a station with no passengers, but a single locked suitcase.

fields.title: The Martian
fields.description: An astronaut becomes stranded on Mars after his team assume him dead, and must rely on his ingenuity to find a way to signal to Earth.

fields.title: Inglourious Basterds
fields.description: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a plan to assassinate Nazi leaders by a group of Jewish U.S. soldiers coincides with a theatre owner's vengeful plans.

fields.title: 12 Angry Men
fields.description: The jury in a New York City murder trial is frustrated by a single member whose skeptical caution forces them to more carefully consider the evidence.

fields.title: Your Name
fields.description: Two strangers find themselves linked in a bizarre way. When a connection forms, will distance be the only thing to keep them apart?

fields.title: The Big Lebowski
fields.description: Jeff 'The Dude' Lebowski, mistaken for a millionaire of the same name, seeks restitution for his ruined rug.

fields.title: Blade Runner
fields.description: A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.

fields.title: City of God
fields.description: In the slums of Rio, two kids' paths diverge as one struggles to become a photographer and the other a kingpin.

fields.title: Oldboy
fields.description: After being kidnapped and imprisoned for fifteen years, Oh Dae-su is released, only to find that he must find his captor in five days.

fields.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
fields.description: When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories.

fields.title: Requiem for a Dream
fields.description: The drug-induced utopias of four Coney Island people are shattered when their addictions run deep.

fields.title: The Truman Show
fields.description: An insurance salesman discovers his whole life is actually a reality TV show vicariously lived by the world.
